faq.q: What is a Shopify AI product photo tool?
faq.a: It turns your product image into a fresh photo for your Shopify store. Choose a new background and lighting without booking a studio.

faq.q: What should the upload look like?
faq.a: Upload a clear, well-lit photo showing the whole product. That helps the finished image keep the shape and details shoppers expect.

faq.q: How much does a Shopify product photo cost?
faq.a: One product photo costs 24 credits. Starter costs $24.50 for 200 credits, Pro costs $35 for 300, and Premium costs $63 for 600.

faq.q: How does a Shopify product photo get made?
faq.a: Upload a clear product photo and describe the scene you want. Make a finished image in minutes for your Shopify product page.

faq.q: Are these photos a fit for a Shopify store?
faq.a: Yes. Use consistent product photos across your Shopify pages and ads. New scenes can help shoppers picture the item without a studio shoot.

faq.q: Can I refresh a whole collection together?
faq.a: Yes. Create new photos for many products with a consistent look. Each image costs 24 credits, and failed jobs return their credits.

faq.q: How can I make better Shopify product photos?
faq.a: Start with a clear photo of the product you sell. Create realistic scenes and consistent backgrounds for your store without another shoot.

faq.q: What does a Shopify product photo tool give you?
faq.a: You get more realistic scenes and backgrounds from a product photo you already have. Make several versions and choose the best fit for your store.

faq.q: Can I use the photos on my store and in ads?
faq.a: Yes. Use watermark-free photos on Shopify and in paid ads. You need rights to the product image you upload.
